notes.title: December 3rd Parch Notes
notes.content: Because we recieved some reports of the game not running well on 4k screens we implented Dynamic resolution which should help to run the game in in these high resolutions. It can be disabled and changed in quality in the settings menu.

notes.title: November 27th Patch Notes
notes.content:
[olist]
[*]Improved water bucket
[*]Water will now come out when bucket faces below 90 degrees (it had to face straight down before to emit water)
[/olist]

notes.title: November 20th Patch Notes
notes.content:
[olist]
[*]Added controller mapping to settings menu (you can now assign controllers to player 1 and 2)
[*]Polished settings gameplay menu
[*]Polished friend invite menu
[*]Fixed some bugs related to opening steam overlay in main menu interfering with ingame UI
[/olist]

notes.title: November 15th Patch Notes
notes.content:
1. Added a button to use "Steam Remote Play together" from the menu.
2. Some debugging for remote play together
3. Some debugging for controllers not showing up correctly

notes.title: November 14th Patch Notes
notes.content:
[olist]
[*]Added Steam controller support (you should now be able to play the game with offbrand controllers)
[*]Added a controller connected heads up display (shows how many controllers are connected / if player 2 has joined the game)
[*]Added Prompt to main menu that explains that two controllers are required to play co-op
[*]Added 16:10 resolutions in settings resolutions dropdown
[*]Fixed a bug where wrong glyphs would be displayed on UI if controllertype was not XBox / PS4
[*]Fixed a bug where main menu navigation did not work
[/olist]

notes.title: November 9th Patch Notes
notes.content:
[olist]
[*]Fixed a bug where opening Steam overlay in main menu would open main menu panel
[/olist]

notes.title: November 8th Patch Notes
notes.content:
[olist]
[*]Fixed a bug where limb movement would be affected by frame rate
[*]Fixed a bug where there was a possibility of having quests persist over scene changes leading to two quest log UI elements overlapping each other
[/olist]

notes.title: November 5th Patch Notes
notes.content:
[olist]
[*]Fixed a bug where stars in main menu would not be displayed correctly
[*]Fixed a bug where Steam Achievements Slowpoke and Sheperd could not be completed
[/olist]

notes.title: November 4th Patch Notes
notes.content:
[olist]
[*]Fixed a bug where dead character limbs could activate respawns
[*]Fixed a quest related bug in Bandit Camp 2
[*]Fixed a bug where detaching attached objects (mushrooms) would not reset their constraints leading to them being able to roll off the playing plane
[*]Removed wishlist button from main menu (since you bought the game already you probably won't have to wishlist it anymore)
[*]Fixed a bug where Twitch integration user prompt was hiding behind Questlog
[/olist]

notes.title: Low FPS Hotfix
notes.content: - Fixed a bug where running the game with low FPS (below 30) would break the player puppet when getting up

notes.title: Check Out Limbs during the Remote Play Together Festival!
notes.content: Check out the developers play the game in two player mode in the livestream. The demo is available for download and supports the remote play together feature, so try it out for yourself!

notes.title: Dev Livestream
notes.content: In this prerecorded stream the two developers of LIMBS play through the demo and talk about various things in the game or that happened during development. Limbs is a funny game but quite difficult to play as you take control over the limbs of your character directly. Check the demo out now!

notes.title: Limbs Demo Dev Stream
notes.content: The are Developers showcasing their demo while talking about various things in the game. Watch us make this game look easy, but I assure you it is in fact quite difficult to do this yourself. Its very manual and indirect controls make for a unique experience as a puppeteer.

notes.title: Demo for Steam Next Fest released early
notes.content:
The updated [b]Demo [/b]for the funny physics game [b]LIMBS [/b]is now live, just in time for the upcoming [b]Steam Next Festival[/b]. Try our game now also with [b]Mouse and Keyboard [/b]controls! But be warned, the game is still most enjoyable with a controller and a friend. Try the [b]remote play together [/b]feature too if you want to play as two players, or just plug in two controllers!

The [b]Twich integration [/b]has also been extended: Chatters might now be able to throw rotten fruit (yes, tomatoes are indeed fruit) at their favourite streamers!

notes.title: Limbs Demo Released!
notes.content:
Take control of a puppet and pull it to victory by completing simple tasks. Well, they might be simple in another game but you could find them quite challenging here!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43606087/6c201844cc2c6d16b2a21307475dea04040156b5.png[/img]

The demo has 5 levels and an expected playtime from 10-30min. It also features a twitch integration we added for the event where chatters can spawn in as critters in some of the levels.

We look forward to seeing our game in the streams of Yogscast! Check out the event here:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/tinyteamsfestival2023]Tiny Teams Festival[/url]
